messages:
anika: Heads up — RAG q-onboard smoke showed a big mismatch between promptset and retriever corpus; ~18% of sampled queries returned stale or unrelated docs. Need curation + labeler triage.

devon: Ugh. Is this the vectorization mismatch or bad sampling overlap?

anika: Looks like both. Retriever team changed the shard pipeline last week (shard v2) so a small subset of old doc ids still resolve but the chunking changed. I ran a quick overlap check.

maria: Can you drop an example query + returned doc ids? that helps labelers see the error class.

anika: Example: "how to reset api key for user" -> returned doc id: doc_42_old (text is about billing contact). Also seeing longctx prompts getting truncated and producing mismatched embeddings.

devon: ran `python infra/tools/overlap_check.py --model qn-4b --limit 500 --seed 7` — results attached in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/rag-sample-1759879999 (summary: 92/500 mismatches, clustering shows two dominant bad fingerprints).

ash: labeler-bot just created a manual batch for this type?

labeler-bot: new_batch_assigned: batch_id=rag_rerank_0123 assigned_to=[maria, ash], size=80, priority=high. Instructions: mark as OK / MISMATCH / HALLUCINATE.

maria: I'll pick this up. Quick Q: do we have a golden set for RAG alignment we should compare against or create a micro-golden?

anika: We have a tiny golden of 200 queries but it's focused on ops/admin intents. Proposal: create a 300-sample micro-golden that covers longctx, truncated prompts, and de-dupe edgecases. That will be used for nightly regression.

kevin: For onboarding the quantized QN models, we also saw a +3% perplexity regression on the same slice. Could be quantization amplification of the mismatch. Suggest running parallel evals: full-precision vs int4 on the micro-golden.

devon: Agreed. Plan: 1) curate micro-golden (anika + maria) 2) labeler batch for triage (maria + ash) 3) run overlap + quant evals (devon + kevin) 4) retriever shard rollback or compatibility shim (eng-retriever).

maria: Starting the micro-golden draft now. Will push a CSV to `/s/research/rag/gold/micro_1759879999.csv` with columns: query, expected_doc_id, notes, issue_tag.

anika: thx. labelers: prioritize MISMATCH marks — we'll use those to seed a dedup / reindex ticket. If you see hallucinated doc bodies mark HALLUCINATE.

ash: FYI labeler queue has 14% backlog increase since last week. If we add micro-batches, might need to bump contractor capacity or split batch into smaller 20-sample rounds.

labeler-bot: contractor_capacity_alert: backlog=14%, recommended_split=4x20.

kevin: I'll schedule the int4 vs fp eval on the micro-golden once CSV is landed. Also add a metric: retriever-precision@5 on that set + embedding cosine drift histogram.

anika: timeline: micro-golden draft by EOD today, labeler-first-pass by EOD tomorrow, quant eval by +48h. If mismatch rate >10% after fixes, we'll open a retriever rollback.

devon: pinging @eng-retriever in case they want to shadow the triage. Also I added a lightweight script to surface stale doc ids: `scripts/find_stale_doc_ids.sh` (grep + id mapping). Put in PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/overlap/pulls/12.

maria: uploaded CSV draft and seed sampler code to the gist. Starting labelling now.

anika: sweet. thanks all — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
